item.title: Connacht Rugby Celebrates Official Opening of redeveloped Dexcom Stadium
item.description: Connacht Rugby has celebrated the official opening of the newly revamped Dexcom Stadium, formerly known as The Sportsground, this weekend. item.title: Fibre Broadband rollout surpasses 30,000 homes in Galway
item.description: The rollout of the National Broadband Plan has now surpassed 30,000 homes, farms, and businesses in Galway. Some 30,800 properties in Galway can now connect to the NBI fibre broadband network with the recent completion of works in Oughterard and Clifden. item.title: University of Galway celebrate 21 years of Teddy Bear Hospital
item.description: For the 21st year running, University of Galway has opened its doors for its award-winning, student-led, Teddy Bear Hospital. The two-day event saw more than 1,200 “sick and injured” teddy bears admitted to the hospital, accompanied by their minders – 1,200 primary school children.
